====================
canonical scalar type spellings and alias boundaries
====================

CREATE TYPE canonical.scalar_types AS OBJECT (
    boolean_value BOOLEAN,
    integer_count INTEGER,
    character_large_object_name CHARACTER LARGE OBJECT,
    binary_large_object_name BINARY LARGE OBJECT,
    bool_alias BOOL,
    int_alias INT,
    text_alias TEXT,
    bytes_alias BYTES
);
